ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface; high-intensity pixels are primarily confined to external barnacle clusters and water spray rather than pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid contiguous black field across both lobes; no distinct high-contrast geometric pigmentation blobs or mottling visible on the fluke skin itself.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an acute angle approximately between 55 and 65 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge; distinct peaks and deep valleys with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 to 20 pixels across the continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the trailing edges tapering into sharp, upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, textured brownish-white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible circular ring-shaped scars on the mid-to-lower section of the right lobe; extensive barnacle encrustations on the lobe tips.
